Use the front in Panarchy Block 1 (part A) and Block 2 (part B). An **opportunity** is a place where a change at one level can unlock a change at another level. A **barrier** is a place where one level blocks another. Note the level of each. The sheet belongs to you. The instructors do not collect it.

```{=typst}
#columns(2, gutter: 1.2cm)[
#set table(rows: (auto, 1.0cm))
```

## Action Plan

Complete the Action Plan alone, for your own Research Use. Use your findings from part A or part B. Then a peer reviews it.

::: {.worksheet}

| Field                                           | Notes |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| My Research Use                                 |       |
| My challenge                                    |       |
| Intended change: what will be different?        |       |
| Next step: what do I do first?                  |       |
| Barriers: what can stop me, and how do I react? |       |
| Timeline: by when?                              |       |
| Success indicator: how do I see the change?     |       |
| Peer review: the main feedback                  |       |
| What I change after the peer review             |       |

: Individual Action Plan {tbl-colwidths="[30,70]"}

:::
